items.statement: Nestlé India has unlocked approximately 18,000 productive hours monthly by having over 3,500 employees use Microsoft 365 Copilot.
items.quote: 3,500+ employees leveraging Microsoft 365 Copilot to work smarter and faster. ~18,000 productive hours unlocked monthly, with ~18% MoM growth in adoption intensity.

items.statement: India has become the second largest market for Nestlé's Out-of-Home business within Zone AOA.
items.quote: India is the second largest market for Nestlé Out-of-Home business in Zone AOA

items.statement: Management expects overall consumption and food and beverage growth to be key areas to watch in the short term due to inflation from the West Asia conflict and monsoon expectations.
items.quote: Inflation impacted by West Asia conflict and monsoon expectation (El Nino) Overall consumption and F&B growth a watchout in the short-term

items.statement: Cold beverages are driving the next wave of coffee consumption in India.
items.quote: Cold driving the next wave of India’s coffee consumption Cold consumption in India’s coffee cups

items.statement: Shipping disruptions, elevated freight costs, and global pressure on raw material availability are creating headwinds for the company.
items.quote: Shipping disruptions and elevated freight costs Global pressure on raw material availability and supply chains Currency and commodity market volatility

items.statement: Nestlé India is leveraging the growing importance of e-commerce as a launchpad for new products and to win premium consumers.
items.quote: Leveraging increasing salience of E-commerce Winning with premium consumers Launchpad for new products

items.statement: The company's Sales Officer Application provides real-time insights and actionable nudges to drive business performance.
items.quote: Real-time insights, actionable nudges, and market execution visibility to drive business performance on the go.

items.statement: Nestlé's global research and development organization is the largest within the food and beverage industry.
items.quote: Global Nestlé’s R&D organization largest in the food and beverage industry

items.statement: Management notes that potential risks and uncertainties include changes in general economic, political, or market conditions.
items.quote: Potential uncertainties and risks include but are not limited to factors such as changes in general economic, political or market conditions

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Poised to capture India's growth opportunity Consumer-centric in a rapidly evolving marketplace Dual engine of growth: Core and premiumization

items.statement: The company has increased its cost savings from the typical 1.8% to 1.9% range to 2.6% in 2025, with further acceleration expected this year.
items.quote: In a normal year, we would be around 1.8 to 1.9%, we have really stepped up, we have gone to 2.6% in 2025 and this year we are further accelerating on that.

items.statement: The company's premiumization efforts have performed well over the past few years and are continuing to accelerate.
items.quote: our premiumization drive has done well over the last few years and continue to accelerate, especially with some of our channel partners providing the right platform like q-commerce and e -commerce.

items.statement: The company is experiencing a slight slowdown in market growth along with some impact from food inflation.
items.quote: The fact is, we are seeing a little bit of slowdown in market growth, as reported by Nielsen, also there is a little bit of impact on food inflation

items.statement: Management believes India offers one of the most attractive long-term consumption opportunities among all the countries where Nestlé operates.
items.quote: We believe that India continues to offer one of the most compelling long-term consumption stories and this is across, I am saying, the 190 countries which Nestlé operates in.

items.statement: The company plans to deliver and maintain its margins in line with its historical performance.
items.quote: We will deliver and maintain our margin in line with our past track record.

items.statement: India's consumption landscape is entering a new phase driven by a rapidly growing middle and affluent consumer base.
items.quote: India's consumption story is very, very clearly entering a new phase, the rapidly expanding middle and affluent consumer base, it really creates some very, very exciting opportunities across those tiers.

items.statement: The company must innovate to offer value at key price points for consumers while maintaining its profitability.
items.quote: And therefore, as a company, we need to innovate to make sure we can deliver those price points value to our consumers at the same time while maintaining a certain profitability.

items.statement: The company is facing rising costs for energy, packaging, oil, and shipping disruptions, alongside currency volatility.
items.quote: There are some costs which are going up of things like energy, packaging, oil, shipping disruptions, there is volatility in the currency, does it concern us? Yes.

items.statement: The company is not pursuing growth at the expense of margins and intends to maintain them in line with historical performance.
items.quote: We are not chasing growth at the cost of margin. We will deliver and maintain our margin in line with our past track record.

items.statement: The company has invested over 64 billion in capital expenditure over the past five years.
items.quote: So, if you look at the last five years, we have invested more than 64 billion.

items.statement: Within the last calendar year, the company launched a new MAGGI line with an investment of over 170 Crores and a new Munch line with an investment of approximately 225 Crores.
items.quote: In the last one calendar year, we started a new MAGGI line with close to Rs.170 Crores plus investment, a new Munch line where again we invested close to Rs.225 Crores

items.statement: The company has launched India's first large-scale dispensing machine, featuring a red and blue design.
items.quote: We launched these machines, if you look at that machine with that red and blue, it is India’s first dispensing machine at scale.

items.statement: The company recently introduced Nestlé NAN EXCELLAPRO, which contains five HMOs combined with probiotics.
items.quote: For example, we just launched Nestlé NAN EXCELLAPRO with five HMOs and probiotics together.

items.statement: Nestlé India is actively helping to shape the growth story of the country's food and beverage industry.
items.quote: Nestlé India, in a big, big way, is not just participating in the growth story in this country, I believe we are helping shape it, especially in the food and beverage part of the industry.
